title: The Convergence Century
subtitle: Closing Global Gaps in Income, Technology, Infrastructure and Living Standards
description: An H Heuristics flagship monograph within the Polycrisis Resilience Series—concept developed by Hunter Hughes—establishing the 21st century as The Convergence…
contribution: Establishes the 21st century as The Convergence Century—concept developed by Hunter Hughes, Founder of H Heuristics—uniting Income, Technology, Infrastructure, and Living Standards with sustainable development, institutional capacity, and Polycrisis Resilience through 2100.
abstract: The Convergence Century is a flagship publication within the H Heuristics Polycrisis Resilience Series, based on the concept developed by Hunter Hughes, Founder of H Heuristics (https://polycrisisresilience.hheuristics.com/).

keyFindings.title: Establishing the 21st century as The Convergence Century aligns global development around closing four interconnected gaps—Income, Technology, Infrastructure, and Living Standards— rather than managing crises in fragmented silos.
Under The Convergence Century pathway, the Global Convergence Index rises from 42.0 (2025) to 73.5 by 2050 and 92.5 by 2100, compared with stagnation at 37.5 under Divergent Fragmentation.
Global South GDP per capita rises from 24.5% to 86.0% of the OECD frontier by 2100, clean-tech and digital access reaches 96–99%, and composite Living Standards climb from 51 to 95.
Embedding Polycrisis Resilience and clean technology into catch-up infrastructure yields a 12.3x 25-year social benefit-cost ratio and lifts all emerging macro-regions to 87.5–94.0 by 2100.
